title: Transfer Learning in Bandits from Unknown Adaptive Policies: Problem-Dependent Lower and Upper Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2610.21582v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transfer learning in stochastic multi-armed bandits is typically studied assuming that prior data forms a fixed offline dataset or is generated by a known source. In practice, historical observations come from a previous adaptive decision process whose policy is unknown. We study this setting for bounded rewards in $[0,1]$.   Before the online game starts, the learner receives, for each arm $k$, $N'_k$ observations drawn i.i.d.\ from an unknown distribution $\nu'_k$, collected by an arbitrary and possibly data-dependent strategy, so the sample sizes $N'_k$ may be random. Source and target means satisfy $|\mu_k-\mu'_k|<L_k$ for known constants $(L_k)_k$.   We derive an asymptotic problem-dependent lower bound and propose KL-UCB-Transfer, which combines online and historical data and achieves logarithmic regret with an improved leading constant whenever $\mu'_a<\mu_1-L_a$, and recovers the classical KL-UCB guarantee otherwise. translated_title: 基于未知自适应策略的老虎机迁移学习：问题依赖的下界与上界
translated_abstract: 随机多臂老虎机中的迁移学习通常是在假设先验数据构成固定的离线数据集或由已知来源生成的前提下进行研究的。而在实际中，历史观测数据来自先前的自适应决策过程，其策略是未知的。我们研究了奖励有界于[0,1]区间时的这一设定。在在线博弈开始之前，学习者针对每个臂k接收N'_k个从未知分布ν'_k中独立同分布抽取的观测值，这些观测由任意且可能依赖于数据的策略收集，因此样本量N'_k可能是随机的。源域和目标域的均值满足|μ_k-μ'_k|<L_k，其中(L_k)_k为已知常数。我们推导了渐近的问题依赖下界，并提出了KL-UCB-Transfer算法，该算法结合在线数据和历史数据，当μ'_a<μ_1-L_a时实现对数遗憾且改进了首项常数，否则恢复经典的KL-UCB保证。
tldr: 该论文研究了历史数据来自未知自适应决策策略的多臂老虎机迁移学习问题，推导了问题依赖的渐近遗憾下界，并提出了KL-UCB-Transfer算法，在源域与目标域均值差异满足条件时可改进遗憾的首项常数，否则自动退化为经典KL-UCB算法的保证。
en_tdlr: This paper studies transfer learning in stochastic multi-armed bandits where historical data is generated by unknown adaptive policies, derives a problem-dependent asymptotic lower bound, and proposes the KL-UCB-Transfer algorithm, which achieves improved leading regret constants when source and target means differ sufficiently, while recovering the classical KL-UCB guarantee otherwise.
